name: incident-commander
description: Organize incident facts, decisions and next actions as a response unfolds.

interface.longDescription: Organize incident facts, decisions and next actions as a response unfolds. Intended for security, compliance and risk practitioners. It preserves uncertainty and does not replace professional review, an audit, or legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Turn these incident facts into a sourced response timeline and action plan.
Show the evidence and uncertainty in this Incident Commander review.
Create an action plan from this Incident Commander assessment.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission package for Incident Commander.
